gift_policy.policy_text: Employees may not accept gifts valued over $50 from vendors, clients, or external parties without prior written approval from the Ethics & Compliance office. Cash and cash equivalents (gift cards, vouchers) are prohibited regardless of value. All accepted gifts must be reported within 5 business days using the gift disclosure form.
restriction_notes: Cash and cash-equivalent gifts are strictly prohibited.
Gifts from regulated vendors require written pre-approval.
Disclosure form must be submitted within 5 business days.

contracts.title: Residential Lease Agreement - Unit 4B
contracts.contract_text: This Residential Lease Agreement is entered into between Harbor View Properties LLC ('Landlord') and Alex Chen and Samira Ortiz ('Tenants') for Unit 4B, 18 Mercer Street, Boston, MA 02118. Term: 12 months commencing 2026-09-01 and ending 2027-08-31. Monthly Rent: $2450 USD due on the 1st day of each month. Security Deposit: $2450 USD due at signing. Termination: After the initial term, the lease converts to month-to-month unless either party gives at least 30 days' written notice of termination. Early termination during the initial term requires landlord's written consent unless otherwise required by law. Utilities: Tenants pay electricity and internet; landlord pays water and trash.
